# My dream coding project: ecotrack 
## Project overview
**Ecotrack** is an app designed to help users *track their daily carbon footprint* and make small, sustainable choices that add up to a big impact its built using **HTML**, **CSS** and **Java script** - but one day I want to epand it into a full web platform

---
## Project Goals
- build a user freindlt dashboard that tracks;
- energy use
- transportation impact
- food consumption patterns 
- Display personalized reports using:
- `console.log()`to debug progress
``` 
if (carbonScore < 50) {
console.log("great job staying exo-freindly!");
} else {
    console.log("Lets find ways to reduce your footprint");
}
```
